title: Research: prove the eleven-line anchor-box floor seven
body:
Eleven rational lines with three totals, nonzero diagonal pairings and nonempty canonical tied sets now admit an anchor box of **at least seven**. The new analytic matrix theorem works over **any field**: a rank-at-most-three eleven-by-eleven matrix with nonzero diagonal contains an ordered nonzero four-block. Its seven-row complement supplies a triple, and the retained asymmetric labels give the box witness.

The proof first obtains a half-size ordered block in rank two, then excludes repeated projective factor directions in an alleged eleven-row obstruction. The remaining zero lines would each contain at least four of eleven distinct points, requiring at least **66 distinct point pairs where only 55 exist**. `PROOF.md` includes the needed seven-row lemma from PR #3420, so the analytic argument is self-contained.

The focused package is `research/fstar-eleven-line-floor/`. It includes the proof, exact constructor, finite semantic controls, source pins and open next question. The `(4,4,3)` duplication of Aaron Wang's PR #2978 core has box exactly eight; it is a positive control, **not a sharpness example for seven**.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12.15 normal and isolated/optimized/warnings-as-errors replay; exact source bytes, metadata/pins, publication source history and whitespace checks. The executable controls do not replace the analytic proof or constitute an exhaustive matrix census. Same-session agents audited the proof and package; this is not independent human acceptance or formal proof checking.

Attribution: DreamingOfClouds's PR #1590/#2111 F-star/certificate definitions, Aaron Wang/navinor's PR #2914/#2978/#3031 directed-box/SG/core lineage, and the PR #3409/#3420 two-block and seven-row lemmas are retained. The oracle is exported unchanged from corrected PR #3393 at `8e1e574fa68465dc0ec69d07852266b9597f9597`, through PR #3420 head `e2d39da9c7109f361d6cff677cf9f8eba51f3dd6`. `SOURCES.json` records exact lineage and assistance disclosures.

Coordination: [canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19009289). This starts from refreshed canonical main and preserves the selected frontier.

Limits: nonempty ties remain an explicit hypothesis. Sharpness at seven, the next twelve-line floor-eight threshold, general F-star and physical supplier admission remain open. κ is unchanged.
